scripts.text:
USE PDS_2008

PRINT 'SCRIPT RUNNING ON SERVER: ' + @@SERVERNAME + CHAR(10)

PRINT '>>> INSERTING NEW RECORDS FROM PDS_NY_PA_STAGING INTO BACKUP OF PDS_NY_PA_STAGING ...'

INSERT INTO TMP_BKP_PDS_NY_PA_STAGING (
	[NY_PA_STAGING_pyID]
    ,[NY_PA_STAGING_MEMBERNUMBER]
    ,[NY_PA_STAGING_PROVIDERID]
    ,[NY_PA_STAGING_CSCS_ID]
    ,[NY_PA_STAGING_CREATE_DATE]
    ,[NY_PA_STAGING_CLOSE_DATE]
    ,[NY_PA_STAGING_WORK_STATUS]
    ,[NY_PA_STAGING_CASE_STATUS]
    ,[NY_PA_STAGING_CLOSE_REASON]
    ,[PROVIDER_NPI]
    ,[PROVIDER_PHONE]
    ,[FILEIMPORT_IID]
    ,[PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME]
    ,[PROVIDER_LAST_NAME]
    ,[PROVIDER_ADDRESS1]
    ,[PROVIDER_CITY]
    ,[PROVIDER_STATE]
    ,[PROVIDER_ZIP]
    ,[PROVIDER_STATE_LICENSE_ID]
    ,[PROVIDER_DEA]
    ,[PROVIDER_TAXONOMY]
    ,[NY_PA_STAGING_UPDATE_DATE])
SELECT 
	S.[NY_PA_STAGING_pyID]
    ,S.[NY_PA_STAGING_MEMBERNUMBER]
    ,S.[NY_PA_STAGING_PROVIDERID]
    ,S.[NY_PA_STAGING_CSCS_ID]
    ,S.[NY_PA_STAGING_CREATE_DATE]
    ,S.[NY_PA_STAGING_CLOSE_DATE]
    ,S.[NY_PA_STAGING_WORK_STATUS]
    ,S.[NY_PA_STAGING_CASE_STATUS]
    ,S.[NY_PA_STAGING_CLOSE_REASON]
    ,S.[PROVIDER_NPI]
    ,S.[PROVIDER_PHONE]
    ,S.[FILEIMPORT_IID]
    ,S.[PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME]
    ,S.[PROVIDER_LAST_NAME]
    ,S.[PROVIDER_ADDRESS1]
    ,S.[PROVIDER_CITY]
    ,S.[PROVIDER_STATE]
    ,S.[PROVIDER_ZIP]
    ,S.[PROVIDER_STATE_LICENSE_ID]
    ,S.[PROVIDER_DEA]
    ,S.[PROVIDER_TAXONOMY]
    ,S.[NY_PA_STAGING_UPDATE_DATE]
FROM PDS_NY_PA_STAGING S
	LEFT OUTER JOIN TMP_BKP_PDS_NY_PA_STAGING B ON S.NY_PA_STAGING_pyID = B.NY_PA_STAGING_pyID
WHERE B.NY_PA_STAGING_pyID IS NULL

IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM PDS_NY_PA_STAGING S LEFT OUTER JOIN TMP_BKP_PDS_NY_PA_STAGING B ON S.NY_PA_STAGING_pyID = B.NY_PA_STAGING_pyID WHERE B.NY_PA_STAGING_pyID IS NULL)
BEGIN
	PRINT '>>> INSERTED NEW RECORDS FROM PDS_NY_PA_STAGING INTO BACKUP OF PDS_NY_PA_STAGING.'
	PRINT '>>> TRUNCATING PDS_NY_PA_STAGING ...'
	TRUNCATE TABLE PDS_NY_PA_STAGING
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM PDS_NY_PA_STAGING)
	BEGIN
		PRINT '>>> TRUNCATED PDS_NY_PA_STAGING.'
		PRINT '>>> RELOADING PDS_NY_PA_STAGING FROM TMP_BKP_PDS_NY_PA_STAGING ...'

		SET IDENTITY_INSERT PDS_NY_PA_STAGING ON

		INSERT INTO PDS_NY_PA_STAGING (
			[NY_PA_IID]
		   ,[NY_PA_STAGING_pyID]
           ,[NY_PA_STAGING_MEMBERNUMBER]
           ,[NY_PA_STAGING_PROVIDERID]
           ,[NY_PA_STAGING_CSCS_ID]
           ,[NY_PA_STAGING_CREATE_DATE]
           ,[NY_PA_STAGING_CLOSE_DATE]
           ,[NY_PA_STAGING_WORK_STATUS]
           ,[NY_PA_STAGING_CASE_STATUS]
           ,[NY_PA_STAGING_CLOSE_REASON]
           ,[PROVIDER_NPI]
           ,[PROVIDER_PHONE]
           ,[FILEIMPORT_IID]
           ,[PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME]
           ,[PROVIDER_LAST_NAME]
           ,[PROVIDER_ADDRESS1]
           ,[PROVIDER_CITY]
           ,[PROVIDER_STATE]
           ,[PROVIDER_ZIP]
           ,[PROVIDER_STATE_LICENSE_ID]
           ,[PROVIDER_DEA]
           ,[PROVIDER_TAXONOMY]
           ,[NY_PA_STAGING_UPDATE_DATE])
		SELECT 
			B.[NY_PA_IID]
		   ,B.[NY_PA_STAGING_pyID]
           ,B.[NY_PA_STAGING_MEMBERNUMBER]
           ,B.[NY_PA_STAGING_PROVIDERID]
           ,B.[NY_PA_STAGING_CSCS_ID]
           ,B.[NY_PA_STAGING_CREATE_DATE]
           ,B.[NY_PA_STAGING_CLOSE_DATE]
           ,B.[NY_PA_STAGING_WORK_STATUS]
           ,B.[NY_PA_STAGING_CASE_STATUS]
           ,B.[NY_PA_STAGING_CLOSE_REASON]
           ,B.[PROVIDER_NPI]
           ,B.[PROVIDER_PHONE]
           ,B.[FILEIMPORT_IID]
           ,B.[PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME]
           ,B.[PROVIDER_LAST_NAME]
           ,B.[PROVIDER_ADDRESS1]
           ,B.[PROVIDER_CITY]
           ,B.[PROVIDER_STATE]
           ,B.[PROVIDER_ZIP]
           ,B.[PROVIDER_STATE_LICENSE_ID]
           ,B.[PROVIDER_DEA]
           ,B.[PROVIDER_TAXONOMY]
           ,B.[NY_PA_STAGING_UPDATE_DATE]
		FROM TMP_BKP_PDS_NY_PA_STAGING B

		SET IDENTITY_INSERT PDS_NY_PA_STAGING OFF

		IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM TMP_BKP_PDS_NY_PA_STAGING B LEFT OUTER JOIN PDS_NY_PA_STAGING S ON S.NY_PA_IID = B.NY_PA_IID WHERE S.NY_PA_IID IS NULL)
			PRINT '>>> RELOADED PDS_NY_PA_STAGING FROM TMP_BKP_PDS_NY_PA_STAGING.'
		ELSE
			PRINT '>>> FAILED RELOADING PDS_NY_PA_STAGING FROM TMP_BKP_PDS_NY_PA_STAGING.'
	END
	ELSE
		PRINT '>>> FAILED TRUNCATING PDS_NY_PA_STAGING.'
END
ELSE
	PRINT '>>> FAILED INSERTING NEW RECORDS FROM PDS_NY_PA_STAGING INTO BACKUP OF PDS_NY_PA_STAGING.'
